policy: RESIDENTIAL DWELLING INSURANCE / Policy wording "WD-2026" - Portable Equipment, Repair and Replacement Edition
description: Accidental damage claim on the portable electronics cover. On the Berlin to Munich drive the laptop was flung against the car door during a sharp swerve, cracking the screen and damaging the lower right corner. The electronics shop repaired it and billed the work as one combined line. The settlement is being paid straight to the shop.

lines.1: Laptop accidental damage repair (cracked screen and lower-right corner), settled with supplier | 1 pcs
